_comment: Tier-2: the ShallowWaterApplication element stem is Boussinesq, not ShallowWater. Pitfall (kratos.shallow_water #0). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3: CreateNewElement('ShallowWaterElement2D3N', ...) raises RuntimeError 'The Element "ShallowWaterElement2D3N" is not registered!'; 'BoussinesqElement2D3N' constructs. Distinct from the existing rans_shallowwater_element_naming fixture, which covers the RANS stem. This fixture runs against a real KratosMultiphysics import; with Kratos absent the import fails and the runner records a skip, never a pass. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 puts the CORRECT registered name BoussinesqElement2D3N into the slot where the fixture expects the wrong ShallowWaterElement2D3N, so nothing is rejected. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: rejected_name=ShallowWaterElement2D3N, is not registered. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/shallowwater_element_is_boussinesq_stem && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
